newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: VENEZUELA BOLIVAR ENDS FLAT AT 494.50/495.50/DLR.
newsitem.headline: VENEZUELA BOLIVAR ENDS FLAT AT 494.50/495.50/DLR.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly unchanged at 494.50/495.50 per dollar Monday as the Central Bank met moderate currency demand, traders said.
"The Central Bank set a price and kept it there," one trader said.
After depreciating by two percent in July the bolivar has rallied and stabilized in August thanks to a combination of currency and monetary policy adjustments by the Central Bank.
Traders said they expected the exchange rate to remain broadly flat for the rest of the week.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
